requirement_match.summary: Approved Phase 0 and Phase 1 implemented and locally verified. Related content cannot block the primary article; session deduplication and server loading states have executable evidence. Layout wiring is necessary for the approved no-JS criterion.

security.summary: Private ephemeral client presentation state; server authorization and media protection untouched. Only 401 means anonymous; malformed/failed session responses cannot restore identity or start One Tap. No secrets, persistence, dependencies or production changes.

code_quality.summary: Isolated copy of current source compiles; lint and typecheck pass.184 unit tests pass,10 opt-in skips. Streaming regression fixture adapted to preserved concurrent discovery queries/tags; no concurrent implementation reverted.

failure_paths.summary: Verified timeout, cancel/unmount, concurrent mounts, focus retry, logout invalidation, ignored stale responses, offline/403/429/503/malformed payload, empty and failed related results, missing post metadata, no-JS article body/listing and category navigation.

error_handling.summary: Optional related failures produce safe fallback with a browse link; session checks terminate after ten seconds and permit later revalidation. Primary error boundaries and auth APIs preserved. No private error text exposed.

production_readiness.summary: Reviewed release boundary and rollback. Local implementation is complete; production remains NOT_READY due to live acceptance, independent assurance, historical gateway chain and retained dirty worktree. No deployment authorized or performed.

trade_offs.summary: Measured lower request counts and fixture CLS. Warm LCP/navigation are slightly slower; transfer grows. Linear no-JS fallback lacks full styling parity. Media cache/CDN and Phase 2 changes remain excluded; no general or field speed guarantee.

findings.summary: Without JavaScript, streamed article remained hidden behind the loading shell. A fallback-local stylesheet also missed fast category responses.
findings.resolution: Always-present public layout rules expose streamed main/article cards; direct body and filter navigation pass without JS.

findings.summary: An unconditional shared-session subscription would add public session checks on ineligible admin routes.
findings.resolution: Disabled hook subscription preserves ineligible One Tap behavior; zero public session checks on admin login verified in desktop/mobile.

residual_risks: Local synthetic measurements are not production or field Core Web Vitals.
No-JS content is a readable linear fallback with reduced styling parity.
Public media cache remains no-store to preserve authorization and unpublish semantics.
No authenticated independent reviewer or historical universal gateway transition chain; release remains NOT_READY.
Existing unrelated lint warning and ten skipped opt-in tests remain disclosed.
limitations: Source and browser evidence scoped to approved paths; whole-worktree dirty changes not certified.
Actual OAuth/One Tap provider prompting, installed iOS Safari, media-transfer performance and production deployment untested.
Final documentation-only CocoIndex refresh hit daemon-log sandbox permission failure after a verified READY source snapshot; bounded source/hash/test evidence used, no retry.

Concurrent discovery edits changed the shared article path after measurement; measuredSourceHashes and current sourceHashes are separately retained. Isolated compiled source copy is used to avoid shared .next mutations.
